verdict.rationale: Qodo documents a centralized rule system for defining/enforcing engineering standards (qodo-docs-12), rule generation from PR history via Rule Miner (qodo-docs-13), configuration-as-code via .pr_agent.toml at repo/org level (qodo-docs-11), and CLI/MCP tools to retrieve applicable rules and standards for a task (qodo-docs-7). This covers natural-language rules and centralized/config-driven enforcement well, though explicit support for AST-pattern rules or linked external style guides isn't detailed. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of AST-pattern rule syntax, independent/hands-on confirmation that custom rules are reliably enforced in practice.
